These molecules, in turn, target the DNA polymerase alpha subunit B. The high scores in both paths indicate a strong, consistent relationship between SGN-30 and the subunit, suggesting that SGN-30 may act as a modulator or activator of the downstream targets. The presence of two distinct molecular mediators, P54 and NOX-700, implies that SGN-30 could influence the activity of DNA polymerase alpha subunit B through different mechanisms, possibly by activating or inhibiting the downstream targets. The integration of these pathways highlights the complexity of the relationship, where SGN-30 may exert its effects through multiple, yet interconnected, molecular routes.
